title: Paying with Cash
situation: A customer pays with cash, uses a note and coins, and checks the change.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa lacag caddaan ah bixinaya, wuxuuna isticmaalayaa warqad lacag ah iyo qadaadiic kadibna wuxuu hubinayaa lacagta loo celiyo.
key_phrases: Do you have the exact amount?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I pay in cash?
dialogue.somali: Lacag caddaan ah ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes. Do you have the exact amount?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Ma haysaa qadarka saxda ah?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I have a ten-dollar note.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan haystaa warqad toban doolar ah.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The total is nine dollars and fifty cents.
dialogue.somali: Wadartu waa sagaal doolar iyo konton senti.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I also have two coins.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan kaloo haystaa laba qadaadiic.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Thank you. That is the exact amount.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi waa qadarka saxda ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do I get any change?
dialogue.somali: Wax lacag celin ah ma helayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: No change today.
dialogue.somali: Maanta lacag celin ma jirto.

title: Paying by Credit Card
somali_title: Kaarka deynta oo lacag lagu bixinayo
situation: A customer pays by credit card, tries contactless payment, enters a PIN, and asks about a declined transaction.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa kaarka deynta ku bixinaya lacag, wuxuu isku dayayaa bixinta taabashada, wuxuu gelinayaa PIN, kadibna wuxuu weydiinayaa macaamil diidmay.
key_phrases: Can I pay by credit card?
Please try the card again first.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I pay by credit card?
dialogue.somali: Kaarka deynta ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, you can use contactless.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaad isticmaali kartaa bixinta taabashada.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The card is not reading.
dialogue.somali: Kaarku ma akhrismayo.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Then please enter your PIN.
dialogue.somali: Markaa fadlan geli PIN-kaaga.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It says the transaction was declined.
dialogue.somali: Waxay leedahay macaamilka waa la diiday.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: That sometimes happens with a credit card.
dialogue.somali: Taasi mararka qaar way ku dhacdaa kaarka deynta.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Should I use another card?
dialogue.somali: Kaarka kale ma isticmaalaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Please try the card again first.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan marka hore kaarka mar kale isku day.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Now it says approved.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxay leedahay waa la aqbalay.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Good. Your payment is complete.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Lacag-bixintaadii way dhammaatay.

title: Sending a Mobile Payment
situation: A customer sends a mobile payment to a shop, checks the recipient, and waits for confirmation after one failed transfer.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa dukaanka lacag taleefan ugu diraya, wuxuu hubinayaa qofka qaata, wuxuuna sugayaa xaqiijin kadib markii hal dirid fashilanto.
key_phrases: Check the recipient before you send it again.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I use mobile payment?
dialogue.somali: Lacag taleefan ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes. The shop mobile number is on the screen.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Lambarka taleefanka dukaanku wuxuu ku yaal shaashadda.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Who is the recipient?
dialogue.somali: Yaa lacagta qaadanaya?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The recipient should say Green Market.
dialogue.somali: Qofka qaata waa inuu noqdaa Green Market.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It says the first transfer failed.
dialogue.somali: Waxay leedahay diriddii koowaad way fashilantay.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Check the recipient before you send it again.
dialogue.somali: Hubi qofka qaata ka hor intaadan mar kale dirin.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Now the recipient is correct.
dialogue.somali: Hadda qofka qaata waa sax.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Good. Send the mobile payment now.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Hadda dir lacagta taleefanka.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I have the confirmation now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxaan hayaa xaqiijinta.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Please show me the confirmation code.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan i tus koodhka xaqiijinta.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Here it is on my mobile phone.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan taleefankayga ku jira.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Your payment has arrived.
dialogue.somali: Lacag-bixintaadii way timid.

title: Making a Deposit at the Bank
situation: A customer at a bank deposits cash, checks the account, asks about a later withdrawal, and confirms when the transaction will appear.
somali_situation: Macmiil bangi jooga ayaa lacag caddaan ah dhigaya, wuxuu hubinayaa akoonka, wuxuu weydiinayaa lacag dambe oo la bixin karo, wuxuuna xaqiijinayaa goorta macaamilku muuqanayo.
key_phrases: I would like to make a deposit.
Can I make a withdrawal later?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I would like to make a deposit.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan rabaa inaan lacag dhigo.

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: Of course. Which account should I use?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Akoonkee ayaan isticmaalaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Use my savings account, please.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan isticmaal akoonkayga kaydka.

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: How much are you depositing?
dialogue.somali: Immisa ayaad dhigaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Two hundred dollars in cash.
dialogue.somali: Laba boqol oo doolar oo caddaan ah.

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: I will count it before I post the transaction.
dialogue.somali: Waan tirinayaa ka hor inta aan macaamilka gelin.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Will the transaction appear today?
dialogue.somali: Macaamilku maanta ma muuqan doonaa?

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: Yes, the transaction will appear today.
dialogue.somali: Haa, macaamilku maanta wuu muuqan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I make a withdrawal later?
dialogue.somali: Lacag ma la bixi karaa goor dambe?

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: Yes, but bring your card and ID.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin keen kaarkaaga iyo aqoonsigaaga.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is there a withdrawal limit?
dialogue.somali: Ma jiraa xad lacag-bixineed?

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: There is a daily limit of five hundred dollars.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa jira xad maalinle ah oo ah shan boqol oo doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good to know. What time does the bank close?
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay inaan ogaado. Bangigu goormuu xirmayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: This bank closes at five.
dialogue.somali: Bangigan wuxuu xirmaa shanta.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Then I will come back before five if I need cash.
dialogue.somali: Markaas waan soo noqon doonaa ka hor shanta haddii aan lacag caddaan ah u baahdo.

dialogue.speaker: Bank Teller
dialogue.english: That will be fine. Here is your deposit receipt.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa hagaag. Waa kan rasiidka lacag dhigistaada.

title: Using an ATM
situation: A customer uses an ATM, checks the balance, asks for a receipt, and reacts when the machine retains the card.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa isticmaalaya mashiinka lacagta, wuxuu hubinayaa hadhaaga, wuxuu codsanayaa rasiid, wuxuuna la tacaalayaa marka mashiinku kaarka haysto.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I want to withdraw cash.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan rabaa inaan lacag caddaan ah la baxo.

dialogue.speaker: Helper
dialogue.english: Enter your PIN.
dialogue.somali: Geli lambarkaaga sirta ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Should I check my balance first?
dialogue.somali: Marka hore ma hubiyaa hadhaagayga?

dialogue.speaker: Helper
dialogue.english: Yes, check your balance first.
dialogue.somali: Haa, marka hore hubi hadhaagaaga.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Now I can withdraw fifty dollars.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxaan la bixi karaa konton doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Helper
dialogue.english: Good. Do you want a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Rasiid ma rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please. Wait, the ATM says card retained.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Sug, mashiinku wuxuu leeyahay kaarkii waa la hayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Helper
dialogue.english: Stay here and call the bank number on the machine.
dialogue.somali: Halkan joog oo wac lambarka bangiga ee mashiinka ku yaal.

title: Exchanging Currency
situation: A traveler asks to exchange dollars, checks the exchange rate and commission, and asks for a receipt.
somali_situation: Socdaale ayaa codsanaya inuu doolar sarrifto, wuxuu hubinayaa qiimaha sarrifka iyo lacagta adeegga, wuxuuna codsanayaa rasiid.
key_phrases: What is the exchange rate today?
Can you convert one hundred dollars?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I want to exchange dollars.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan rabaa inaan doolar sarrifto.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Which currency do you need?
dialogue.somali: Lacagtee ayaad u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Somali shillings, please.
dialogue.somali: Shilin Soomaali ah, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The exchange rate is on the screen.
dialogue.somali: Qiimaha sarrifku wuxuu ku yaal shaashadda.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What is the exchange rate today?
dialogue.somali: Maanta qiimaha sarrifku waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: One dollar is this amount in shillings.
dialogue.somali: Hal doolar waa qaddarkan oo shilin ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is there a commission?
dialogue.somali: Lacag adeeg ma jirtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, a small commission.
dialogue.somali: Haa, lacag adeeg oo yar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you convert one hundred dollars? Please give me a receipt.
dialogue.somali: Boqol doolar ma ii beddeli kartaa? Fadlan rasiid i sii.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, I will exchange it now.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hadda ayaan kuu sarrifayaa.

title: Paying an Electricity Bill
situation: A customer pays an electricity bill, checks the amount due and due date, and asks about a late charge.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa bixinaya biilka korontada, wuxuu hubinayaa lacagta la rabo iyo taariikhda kama dambaysta ah, wuxuuna weydiinayaa ganaax dib-u-dhac ah.
key_phrases: I need to pay this bill.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need to pay this bill.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan biilkan bixiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Is it one of your electricity bills?
dialogue.somali: Ma mid ka mid ah biilashaada korontada baa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, it is the electricity bill.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa biilka korontada.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: What is the account number?
dialogue.somali: Lambarka akoonku waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is on the top of the bill.
dialogue.somali: Wuxuu ku yaal dusha biilka.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: I found it. What is the amount due?
dialogue.somali: Waan helay. Lacagta la rabo waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The amount due is eighty dollars.
dialogue.somali: Lacagta la rabo waa siddeetan doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The due date is Friday.
dialogue.somali: Taariikhda kama dambaysta ahi waa Jimce.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What happens after Friday?
dialogue.somali: Maxaa dhaca Jimcaha ka dib?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: There is a late charge.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa jira lacag ganaax dib-u-dhac ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Then I will make the payment now.
dialogue.somali: Markaas hadda ayaan lacagta bixinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Your payment is recorded.
dialogue.somali: Lacag-bixintaada waa la diiwaangeliyay.

title: Asking for a Receipt
situation: A customer asks for a receipt after shopping, chooses a digital receipt, checks the total, and confirms proof of purchase.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa dukaamaysi kadib rasiid codsanaya, wuxuu dooranayaa rasiid dijitaal ah, wuxuu hubinayaa wadarta, wuxuuna xaqiijinayaa caddeynta iibka.
key_phrases: I need proof of purchase for work.
The digital receipt can go to your email.
The total is on the bottom.
Which item was returned on my old receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I have a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Rasiid ma heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Of course. Do you want a paper receipt or a digital receipt?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Rasiid warqad ah mise rasiid dijitaal ah ayaad rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: A digital receipt is fine.
dialogue.somali: Rasiid dijitaal ah waa hagaag.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The digital receipt can go to your email.
dialogue.somali: Rasiidka dijitaalka ah waxaa loo diri karaa iimaylkaaga.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need proof of purchase for work.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan shaqada ugu baahanahay caddeyn iib.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: This receipt is proof of purchase.
dialogue.somali: Rasiidkani waa caddeyn iib.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you show me the total?
dialogue.somali: Wadarta ma i tusi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The total is on the bottom.
dialogue.somali: Wadartu waxay ku taallaa hoose.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I bought three items, correct?
dialogue.somali: Waxaan iibsaday saddex shay, sax miyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, each item is listed here.
dialogue.somali: Haa, shay kasta halkan ayuu ku qoran yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: If I return something later, do I need this receipt?
dialogue.somali: Haddii aan wax soo celiyo goor dambe, rasiidkan ma u baahanahay?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, returns are easier with receipts.
dialogue.somali: Haa, soo celintu way fududahay marka rasiidyo la haysto.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Which item was returned on my old receipt?
dialogue.somali: Shaygee ayaa lagu soo celiyay rasiidkaygii hore?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The blue bag was returned last week.
dialogue.somali: Bacda buluugga ah ayaa la soo celiyay toddobaadkii hore.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good, then this new receipt is clear.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay, markaas rasiidkan cusub wuu cad yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: I sent it to your email now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waxaan u diray iimaylkaaga.

title: Asking for a Refund
situation: A customer returns a faulty item, asks about the return policy, and chooses a replacement instead of store credit.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa soo celinaya shay ciladaysan, wuxuu weydiinayaa xeerka soo celinta, wuxuuna dooranayaa beddel halkii uu ka qaadan lahaa deyn dukaan.
key_phrases: Our return policy allows refunds or store credit.
I do not want store credit.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need a refund.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay lacag-celin.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: What is wrong with the item?
dialogue.somali: Maxaa ka khaldan shayga?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: This item is faulty.
dialogue.somali: Shaygani cilad ayuu leeyahay.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Our return policy allows refunds or store credit.
dialogue.somali: Xeerka soo celintayadu wuxuu oggol yahay lacag-celin ama deyn dukaan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I do not want store credit.
dialogue.somali: Ma rabo deyn dukaan.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Do you prefer a replacement?
dialogue.somali: Ma doorbidaysaa beddel?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, I prefer a replacement.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan doorbidayaa beddel.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: I can give you a replacement today.
dialogue.somali: Maanta waxaan ku siin karaa beddel.

title: Using a Discount at the Shop
situation: A shopper asks whether an item is on sale, checks eligibility, and uses one valid discount before it expires.
somali_situation: Qof dukaamaysanaya ayaa weydiinaya in shaygu iib-dhimis ku jiro, wuxuu hubinayaa inuu xaq u leeyahay, wuxuuna isticmaalayaa hal qiimo-dhimis oo ansax ah ka hor inta uusan dhicin.
key_phrases: The discount is ten percent off.
Am I eligible for the discount?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is this item on sale?
dialogue.somali: Shaygani iib-dhimis ma ku jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, the discount is ten percent off.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qiimo-dhimistu waa boqolkiiba toban.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Am I eligible for the discount?
dialogue.somali: Ma u qalmaa qiimo-dhimista?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, students are eligible today.
dialogue.somali: Haa, ardaydu maanta way u qalmaan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Does the offer expire soon?
dialogue.somali: Dalabku ma dhici doonaa dhowaan?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The offer expires tonight.
dialogue.somali: Dalabku caawa ayuu dhacayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I use two discounts?
dialogue.somali: Laba qiimo-dhimis ma isticmaali karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: No, only one discount at a time.
dialogue.somali: Maya, hal qiimo-dhimis oo keliya mar kasta.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: All right. Please apply it.
dialogue.somali: Hagaag. Fadlan ku dar.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The discount is applied now.
dialogue.somali: Qiimo-dhimistii hadda waa lagu daray.
